refusal_contract.semantics: Only typed untransformable refusals with evidence_complete=true covering every refused path, emitted by a producer listed in complete_evidence_producers (each added only with its end-to-end completeness test), whose every refused span exactly matches ownership-labelled confirmed-ID gold, are blocked operations. Single-path first-error evidence and unsupported encoded carriers are ineligible. Benign/non-gold refusals fail. Layers C/A/D/R without refusals, and dictionary-sequence layers K/B, retain legacy arithmetic. Compare common unblocked operations for bytes, exact restore and valid manifest; refusing creates no gain.
